findings: The plan operates on the exact already-published original log and immutable driver/source identities. It neither reruns the original controls nor alters their recorded outcome.

All seven plan-tree blobs were fetched and checked against their Git blob IDs and lengths. Each of the four included producer/capture/gate sources also matches a fresh direct read at the exact b05127dd driver path.

Fixed source-log, compressed-stream and raw-stream limits constrain the input. The plan requires the original source/driver/frame metadata, ordered unique frames, safe unique relative member names and exact content-address/length/encoding joins.

The producer's sorted JSON stores unique content records before named references; the proposed two-stage streaming extraction can preserve named duplicates while deduplicating content. Byte extraction grants no case or source-validation credit.

The 95 MiB hard address-space bound, 64 KiB I/O chunks, 8 MiB maximum materialized semantic value, 32 MiB streamed member bound, CPU/wall limits and exclusive sandbox handoff keep this readback separate from the prior OOM-prone whole-packet materialization.

Large contracts may be admitted only through bounded field/item scanning that preserves complete schema and joins. Otherwise the affected cohort, and therefore complete 634 verification, remains explicitly incomplete.

Independent finite credit requires ordered collect/run contracts, exact declared selector coverage, unique node identities, all setup/call/teardown records, outcomes and xfail/failure fields, JUnit counts/order/identity and ordered duplicate user properties. The aggregate passed flags or successful job alone cannot supply these observations.

The ten physical cohorts and eight logical groups correctly preserve 593 original cases plus the separately declared 41, 1,902 phases and 298 selector entries. Cross-cohort duplicate identities must be rejected before complete population credit.

Inline definition/provider hashes must join the relevant exact Git source bindings. Source-reported identity and independently reconstructed byte identity remain distinct; unresolved provenance cannot silently receive source-validation credit.

Original owned process-group retirement remains distinct from a complete descendant cleanup certificate. Installed native phases, benchmark eligibility, full qualification and task-status promotions remain false.
implementation_review_conditions: Validate the parser as a separate bounded implementation before reading the large body. Reject duplicate or ambiguous structural metadata keys, invalid JSON escapes/surrogate sequences, unsupported encoding, unsafe names and count/hash/identity mismatch.
Retain ordered duplicate JUnit user properties exactly; do not collapse them into a mapping or infer missing phase/JUnit rows from summaries.
Treat the included producer and gate modules as read-only source references. Do not invoke finite_controls.run, test launchers, report regeneration or native code as part of readback.
Enforce resource limits before input processing, stop on changed sandbox boot or resource-bound failure, and record any partial admission without lifting limits or replacing the original reports.
Keep exact extracted bytes and derived projections separately identified. Persist the resulting bounded records through verified standalone Git objects before relying on transient files.
